g.text: Key features, normal vs attacked samples (54 test flights)

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #666666

g.text: Each sample is one log row. Log scale on the y axis; the 0.5-99.5% range is shown. Real attacks in this dataset are position jumps, so they show mainly in the velocity and position-change
